import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Create a DataFrame from the dataset
data = {
    'amount': [115.02, 44.37, 144.25, 536.22, 38.43],
    'is_fraud': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
    'transaction_type': ['refund', 'payment', 'transfer', 'payment', 'payment'],
    'hour_of_day': [22, 5, 21, 17, 5]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert categorical columns to categorical type
df['transaction_type'] = df['transaction_type'].astype('category')
df['hour_of_day'] = df['hour_of_day'].astype('category')

# Plot a bar chart for transaction types
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', data=df)
plt.title('Transaction Types')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.savefig('transaction_types.png')

# Plot a bar chart for hours of day

plt.savefig('amount_distribution.png')
